Text Metrics Inference.Normalization: NFC; count Unicode code points after excluding str.isspace() and categories Cc/Cf/Cs
Text Metrics Inference.Bytes: UTF-8 encoding of original text fields, without JSON/container/metadata overhead
Text Metrics Inference.Words: sum(len(text.split())); not a linguistic word count for non-space-delimited languages
Text Metrics Inference.Sentences: heuristic punctuation/newline segments unless an explicit sentence-count field is supplied
Text Metrics Inference.Storage: null unless exact attributable stored bytes are provided; transferred bytes and re-gzipped text are not storage size
Text Metrics Inference.CI: 95% percentile document bootstrap conditional on the observed sample; excludes shard/order bias and official-total error
Text Metrics Inference.Official Total Uncertainty: Published document total is itself an extrapolation from the first .json.gz file; CI conditions on that total.
Text Metrics Inference.Scope: CCNet February 2019 complete deduplicated corpus labelled yi

Strata.Sampling Note: Digest- and paragraph-ID-matched CCNet reproduction sample from 60 WET segments; conditional bootstrap excludes between-segment bias.

Text Metrics Inference.Read Budget Note: Each selected official WET file below 500 MB; shared compressed WET bytes are not attributable to a language or a sampled document.

Definitions.document_unit: published approximate number of reconstructed webpages; first-file count scaled by .json.gz file-size ratio
